eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 36 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
SELECT Color, Size, AVG(ListPrice) AS AveragePrice,
       COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
FROM Production.Product
GROUP BY Color, Size;
caption: Red/Large and Red/Small are two SEPARATE groups, each with its own average.

code:
-- DISTINCT removes duplicates on the combination
-- GROUP BY lets you AGGREGATE within it
SELECT DISTINCT Color, Size
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Same underlying comparison — different job once the groups exist.

code:
-- ERROR: ProductLine isn't aggregated, isn't grouped
SELECT Color, Size, ProductLine, AVG(ListPrice)
FROM Production.Product
GROUP BY Color, Size;
caption: Fix: add ProductLine to GROUP BY too.
